title: Communication protocol security
objective: Assess protection of client-to-server communication and authentication cookies.
input: Inspect server deployment settings, HTTPS/TLS configuration, session-cookie attributes and relevant response headers.
expected: The intended deployed environment protects credentials and sensitive data in transit and applies suitable session-cookie settings.
procedure: Inspect local configuration and permitted test responses. Assess a real HTTPS deployment only if an authorized instance is available. Do not treat loopback development HTTP alone as a public vulnerability.
evidence: Configuration excerpts, permitted HTTP/HTTPS captures, cookie attributes, security headers and deployment-scope notes.
